paragraphs.text:
You’re on board. Good work! Suspend further timekeeping and 
make a note that you came aboard at entry 500.
You have won the race to reach The Dark Sea before she sails. 
You probably know your quarry is aboard. Now you have only 
to find him and destroy the Top:
• To seek information about members, go to 492.
• To search member rooms, go to 460.
• To lay low until Antarctica, go to 462.
• To try skill rolls, go to 480.
You can try one activity daily. The trip lasts 26+1D6 days. On 
arrival in Antarctica, go to 520 (note this down).
(462, 464, 466, 488, 489, 531)
